SELECT
    "id",
    "name",
    "event_space",
    "capacity",
    "address",
    "contactinfo"
FROM
    "eventspaces"
WHERE
    LOWER("event_space") IN ('banquet hall', 'conference room')
    AND "capacity" >= 200;
2:
SELECT DISTINCT es."id",
                es."name",
                es."event_space",
                es."capacity",
                es."address",
                es."contactinfo"
FROM "eventspaces" es
WHERE es."capacity" = 200
  AND (
        es."event_space" IN ('banquet hall', 'conference room')
        OR
        LOWER(es."name") LIKE ANY(ARRAY['%банкетный зал%', '%конференц-зал%'])
      );
3:
SELECT
    r."name" AS establishment_name,
    r."address",
    CASE
        WHEN LOWER(r."food_service") LIKE '%restaurant%' THEN 'restaurant'
        WHEN LOWER(r."food_service") LIKE '%cafe%' THEN 'cafe'
        ELSE r."food_service"
    END AS food_service_type
FROM
    "restaurants" r
WHERE
    LOWER(r."cuisine") LIKE '%italian%';

SELECT s."id", s."name", s."role"
FROM "staff" s
WHERE LOWER(s."role") = 'chef'

UNION ALL


SELECT s."id", s."name", s."role"
FROM "staff" s
WHERE LOWER(s."role") = 'server'
  AND LOWER(s."language") = 'english';

    s."id",
    s."name",
    s."role"
FROM
    "staff" s
WHERE
    LOWER(TRIM(s."language")) = 'english'
    AND LOWER(TRIM(s."role")) IN ('chef', 'server');
8:
WITH chefs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        s."id",
        s."name",
        s."language"
    FROM
        "staff" s
    WHERE
        LOWER(s."role") LIKE '%chef%'
),
servers_languages AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        s."language"
    FROM
        "staff" s
    WHERE
        LOWER(s."role") LIKE '%server%'
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    s."id",
    s."name",
    s."role",
    s."language"
FROM
    "staff" s
JOIN
    servers_languages sl ON LOWER(s."language") = LOWER(sl."language")
WHERE
    LOWER(s."role") LIKE '%server%'
    AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM chefs c
        WHERE LOWER(c."language") = LOWER(s."language")
    );

WITH hospital_count AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "hospitalid") AS total_hospitals
    FROM "hospitals"
),
role_hospital_count AS (
    SELECT
        hmr."roleid",
        COUNT(DISTINCT hmr."hospitalid") AS role_hospitals
    FROM "hospitals_medical_roles" hmr
    GROUP BY hmr."roleid"
)
SELECT AVG(mr."salary") AS average_salary
FROM "medicalroles" mr
JOIN "role_hospital_count" rhc ON mr."roleid" = rhc."roleid"
CROSS JOIN "hospital_count" hc
WHERE rhc."role_hospitals" = hc."total_hospitals";

SELECT
    its."id" AS specialist_id,
    its."name" AS specialist_name,
    string_agg(s."system_name", ', ' ORDER BY s."system_name") AS systems
FROM
    "it_support_specialists" its
LEFT JOIN
    "it_support_specialists_systems" itss ON its."id" = itss."it_specialist_id"
LEFT JOIN
    "systems" s ON itss."system_id" = s."system_id"
GROUP BY
    its."id", its."name";
110:
SELECT
    its.id AS it_specialist_id,
    its.name AS it_specialist_name,
    s.system_name,
    s.is_active
FROM
    it_support_specialists its
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT
        s.system_name,
        s.is_active
    FROM
        it_support_specialists_systems itss
    JOIN
        systems s ON itss.system_id = s.system_id
    WHERE
        itss.it_specialist_id = its.id
) s;

WITH responsibility_counts AS (
    SELECT
        r."responsibility",
        COUNT(DISTINCT ir."internshipid") AS internship_count
    FROM
        "responsibilities" r
    JOIN
        "internships_responsibilities" ir ON r."id" = ir."responsibilityid"
    GROUP BY
        r."responsibility"
),
total_internships AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM "internships"
)
SELECT
    rc."responsibility"
FROM
    responsibility_counts rc
CROSS JOIN
    total_internships ti
WHERE
    rc.internship_count = ti.total;

    j."minimum_years" AS min_experience_years,
    j."preferred_years" AS preferred_experience_years
FROM
    "jobs" j
WHERE
    j."salary" = (SELECT MAX("salary") FROM "jobs");

SELECT
    sd."salary_range" AS salary_range,
    sd."hourly_rate" AS hourly_rate
FROM
    "salarydetails" sd
JOIN
    "position" p ON sd."positionid" = p."id"
WHERE
    LOWER(TRIM(p."title")) = 'software developer';
263:
SELECT
    "salary_range" AS typical_hourly_pay_range
FROM
    "salarydetails" sd
JOIN
    "position" p ON sd."positionid" = p."id"
WHERE
    LOWER(p."title") LIKE '%software developer%'
    OR LOWER(p."title") LIKE '%software engineer%'
    OR LOWER(p."description") LIKE '%software developer%'
    OR LOWER(p."description") LIKE '%software engineer%'
GROUP BY
    "salary_range";
